nodes.description: Owned.contractOwner: address of current contract owner, set to msg.sender at construction and used as the sole authorization anchor.
Owned.pendingContractOwner: address staged by changeContractOwnership and promoted to contractOwner by claimContractOwnership.
ATxAssetProxy.latestVersion: implementation contract address used by _getAsset() for all delegated logic.
ATxAssetProxy.platform: immutable platform contract address used for all balance/allowance state.
ATxAssetProxy.smbl: bytes32 asset symbol used to key platform calls.
ATxAssetProxy.name: human readable asset name assigned during init.
ATxAssetProxy.symbol: ERC20 string symbol assigned during init.
Owned(): constructor assigning contractOwner = msg.sender.
destroy(): onlyContractOwner function calling suicide(msg.sender) to destroy the contract.
changeContractOwnership(address _to): owner-only staging of a new owner in pendingContractOwner.
claimContractOwnership(): lets pendingContractOwner take ownership; verifies msg.sender equals pendingContractOwner.
Object.withdrawnTokens(address[] tokens, address _to): owner-only loop performing external ERC20 balanceOf/transfer calls.
checkOnlyContractOwner(): internal view returning OK only when contractOwner == msg.sender.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): multiplication guarded by assert(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): division, reverts on zero divisor.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): addition guarded by assert(c >= a).
ATxAssetProxy fallback function: forwards msg.data and msg.value to the asset implementation via __process.
init(Platform _platform, string _symbol, string _name): one-time initialization of platform, symbol, smbl and name.
transfer(address _to, uint _value): public ERC20 entry deferring to _transferWithReference.
transferWithReference(address _to, uint _value, string _reference): ERC20 transfer with comment.
__transferWithReference(...): onlyAccess(_sender) function calling platform.proxyTransferWithReference.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value): delegates to asset implementation __transferFromWithReference.
__transferFromWithReference(...): onlyAccess(_sender) function calling platform.proxyTransferFromWithReference.
approve(address _spender, uint _value): delegates to asset implementation __approve.
__approve(address _spender, uint _value, address _sender): onlyAccess(_sender) function calling platform.proxyApprove.
emitTransfer(address _from, address _to, uint _value): onlyPlatform event emission.
emitApprove(address _from, address _spender, uint _value): onlyPlatform event emission.
getLatestVersion(): returns latestVersion implementation address.
proposeUpgrade(address _newVersion): onlyAssetOwner sets latestVersion to a non-zero address and emits UpgradeProposal.
isTransferAllowed(...): view hook always returning true.
_getAsset(): internal view wrapping getLatestVersion() into ATxAssetInterface.
_transferWithReference(...): internal helper calling _getAsset().__transferWithReference with msg.sender.
stringToBytes32(string source): private pure assembly conversion using mload.
ATxAssetInterface.__process(bytes,address) payable: default implementation reverting, overridden pattern for delegated execution.
msg.sender used in Owned constructor, onlyContractOwner modifier and checkOnlyContractOwner for ownership authorization.
msg.sender passed with msg.data/msg.value into the proxy fallback delegated call.
msg.sender compared against pendingContractOwner in claimContractOwnership.
suicide(msg.sender) in destroy(): irreversible selfdestruct of the contract.
_getAsset().__process.value(msg.value)(msg.data, msg.sender): arbitrary external/delegated call from the payable fallback.
ERC20Interface(token).balanceOf/transfer(_to, balance) external calls inside withdrawnTokens loop.
platform.proxyTransferWithReference(_to, _value, smbl, _reference, _sender) external state-changing call.
platform.proxyTransferFromWithReference(...) external state-changing call.
platform.proxyApprove(_spender, _value, smbl, _sender) external state-changing call.
_getAsset().__transferFromWithReference / __approve: external call into the mutable implementation contract.
_to recipient address supplied by the caller of transfer/transferWithReference.
_value amount supplied by the caller and forwarded to the platform.
_reference free-text transfer comment forwarded to the platform.
_sender initial caller address used by the onlyAccess(_sender) guard.
_spender address receiving allowance in approve.
_from holder address debited in transferFrom.
_platform address stored during init.
_symbol string stored during init and converted to smbl.
_name string stored during init.
_newVersion implementation address proposed in proposeUpgrade.
tokens address array iterated in withdrawnTokens.
balance local holding ERC20Interface(token).balanceOf(this) in withdrawnTokens.
token local holding tokens[i] inside the withdrawnTokens loop.
i loop counter in withdrawnTokens.
result bytes32 assembly output of stringToBytes32.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns contractOwner = msg.sender.
Authorization of the irreversible suicide() relies solely on the msg.sender == contractOwner comparison.
onlyContractOwner modifier gates destroy() on msg.sender equality with contractOwner.
onlyContractOwner modifier gates withdrawnTokens() on msg.sender equality with contractOwner.
onlyAssetOwner modifier authorizes proposeUpgrade via platform.isOwner(msg.sender, smbl).
Fallback forwards untrusted msg.sender together with msg.data and msg.value into __process.
claimContractOwnership writes contractOwner after comparing untrusted msg.sender to pendingContractOwner.
msg.sender is checked against pendingContractOwner during ownership claim.
changeContractOwnership writes the new owner into pendingContractOwner.
claimContractOwnership promotes pendingContractOwner into contractOwner.
claimContractOwnership deletes pendingContractOwner after the successful claim.
init stores the platform address once.
init stores the ERC20 symbol string.
init stores the bytes32 smbl derived from the symbol.
init stores the asset name string.
proposeUpgrade writes the new implementation into latestVersion.
_to parameter flows from transfer into the internal transfer path.
_to parameter flows through transferWithReference.
_value parameter flows from transfer into the internal transfer path.
_reference parameter flows through transferWithReference.
_sender is both the onlyAccess guard input and the platform call argument in __transferWithReference.
_sender is both the onlyAccess guard input and the platform call argument in __transferFromWithReference.
_spender parameter flows from approve into the delegated call.
_from parameter flows from transferFrom into the delegated call.
_platform parameter is assigned into the platform state variable.
_symbol parameter is assigned into symbol and smbl.
_name parameter is assigned into the name state variable.
_newVersion parameter is assigned into latestVersion.
tokens array drives the external-call loop in withdrawnTokens.
balance local is the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
token local is the target of the external ERC20 balanceOf/transfer calls.
i counter controls loop iteration over tokens in withdrawnTokens.
result local is produced by the assembly mload in stringToBytes32.
destroy() executes suicide(msg.sender).
Fallback invokes the delegated __process call with attacker-controlled calldata.
transfer() delegates to _transferWithReference.
_transferWithReference resolves the implementation through _getAsset().
Internal transfer calls back into the implementation contract's __transferWithReference.
_getAsset reads the implementation address from getLatestVersion().
getLatestVersion returns the latestVersion state variable.
transferFrom calls out to the mutable implementation contract before state settles.
approve calls out to the mutable implementation contract.
__transferWithReference forwards to platform.proxyTransferWithReference.
__transferFromWithReference forwards to platform.proxyTransferFromWithReference.
__approve forwards to platform.proxyApprove.
init calls stringToBytes32 to derive smbl from the symbol string.
withdrawnTokens loop performs external ERC20 balanceOf/transfer calls.
The delegated __process call can re-enter the payable fallback before the call completes.
Untrusted ERC20 token callbacks can re-enter the withdrawnTokens loop.
Platform call may re-enter __transferWithReference.
Platform call may re-enter __transferFromWithReference.
Platform call may re-enter __approve.
Implementation contract may re-enter transferFrom.
SafeMath.add guards value arithmetic that reaches implementation/upgrade state.
SafeMath.sub guards balance accounting used by the withdrawnTokens transfer amount.
